title: Global overview
description: All sites at a glance. Generated by common/dashboards/build_overview.py.

panels.title: Critical alerts
panels.description: Firing critical alerts (includes silenced ones, which do not notify).

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Firing warnings.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets that do not answer (exporters, stack components).

panels.title: Outside checks failing
panels.description: Gatus checks from the internet that currently fail.

panels.title: Hosts reporting
panels.description: Servers whose node_exporter answers.

panels.title: Workstations online
panels.description: Workstations answering ping right now.

panels.title: Site health: share of targets up
panels.description: Per site: fraction of scrape targets answering. Green = all, yellow = some down, red = 10 % or more down. A gap means the site sent no data (see SiteSilent).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Critical and warning alerts of all sites. Silenced alerts are listed too; info alerts are omitted.

panels.title: Down right now
panels.description: Scrape targets, internal service checks and outside checks that fail right now.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Average CPU utilisation over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: RAM in use (MemAvailable based, page cache counts as free).

panels.title: Fullest filesystems
panels.description: Used share of host filesystems. Alert at 90 %.

panels.title: Hosts with security updates
panels.description: Hosts with pending security updates (unattended-upgrades usually installs them within a day).

targets.expr: count(sum by (site, instance) (apt_upgrades_pending{origin=~".*[Ss]ecurity.*", site=~"$site"}) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hosts needing a reboot
panels.description: Kernel or library updates installed but not active until a reboot.

panels.title: Updates pending (all hosts)
panels.description: Total number of pending package updates over all Debian/Ubuntu/Proxmox hosts.

panels.title: Updates per host
panels.description: Pending APT updates per host (refreshed hourly on the host), the security share, and whether a reboot is pending.

targets.expr: sum by (site, instance) (apt_upgrades_pending{origin=~".*[Ss]ecurity.*", site=~"$site"}) or (sum by (site, instance) (apt_upgrades_pending{site=~"$site"}) * 0)

panels.title: Disks with SMART errors
panels.description: Disks reporting SMART failure (includes silenced ones).

panels.title: RAID / ZFS / NAS degraded
panels.description: Degraded ZFS pools, Synology volumes and md RAIDs.

targets.expr: (count(node_zfs_zpool_state{state!="online", site=~"$site"} > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(raidStatus{site=~"$site"} != 1) or vector(0)) + (count(node_md_disks{state="failed", site=~"$site"} > 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Hottest disk
panels.description: Highest current drive temperature.

panels.title: Oldest automation run
panels.description: Time since the oldest successful nightly/weekly self-update job. Alert after 8 days.

panels.title: Drive temperatures (hottest 10)
panels.description: Current SMART temperature per drive.

panels.title: Certificates: days left
panels.description: TLS certificates checked from inside (blackbox) and from the internet (Gatus). Alert below 14 days.

panels.title: Availability from the internet
panels.description: History of every Gatus check. Red stripes are outages as seen from outside. na.uni-tuebingen.de is red on purpose while the university blocks inbound traffic.

panels.title: Workstations online
panels.description: Number of workstations answering ping, per site.

panels.title: Not seen in the selected period
panels.description: Workstations that never answered during the selected time range (switched off, no DNS entry).
